stage: diagnostics only; no fitting without approval of diagnosis-supported candidates
pr_auc: existing Spark BinaryClassificationEvaluator areaUnderPR, numBins=0, natural-prevalence unweighted rows
primary_comparison: equal-month mean of candidate minus baseline PR-AUC; recompute baseline monthly, never subtract pooled PR-AUC
identical_score_and_id_boundary: preserve multiplicity; equal fractional selection weights within the boundary group; report expected precision/recall
training_score_diagnostic: deterministic approximately 1% of training rows using pmod(xxhash64(flight_id),100)=0; in-sample only; full training population used for prevalence and feature profiles

candidate_qualification.monthly_results: report every change and worst month; no additional monthly elimination rule

prohibited_inputs_for_candidate_selectio: September-December 2024 predictions, metrics, and labels; no later untouched evaluation data is present
interpretation: retrospective development-data comparison only; 0.005 is an agreed practical threshold, not statistical significance
candidate_menu: one justified regularization direction: 0.03 or 0.3 versus 0.1
classifier fitting window May 2023-April 2024 only if temporal-drift diagnostics justify it; preprocessing still uses full original training period
production_contracts: unchanged; no acceptance exemptions, publication, or baseline overwrite
